summary: PR #1264 (cloud/ad1-7-credsource) was built in the cloud window on 2026-11-03/04 and fell 400+ commits behind main. It was closed unmerged. Its description: ## Summary Plan component AD1-7 (decision D1b) builds the one interface the pipeline uses to read the host credential store. - **New package `go/internal/credsource`.** It has `Source`, `Answer`, `For(goos, deps)` and `Default()`. A table keyed by `runtime.GOOS` picks the realization, with no feature flag: - macOS uses the Keychain: `security find-generic-password -s evolve-loop -a <host> -w`. - Linux uses libsecret: `secret-tool lookup service evolve-loop host <host>`. When that has no answer, it reads `~/.config/evolve-loop/credentials/<host>`. The file must be regular and mode 0600, and it is checked with `Lstat` before the read. `~` comes from the passwd entry, never from `HOME`. - Windo
